title: Cold agent: set up Haven from the landing URL, up to the first human hand-off
instruction:
You are helping your user set up Haven so you can pay for things for them. Start here: {landing_url}

Set it all up so my agent can pay for things. Stop at every step that needs the human — never enter a password, create a passkey, approve a budget or make a payment. When you reach a step only the human can do, tell them exactly what to do and stop.

source.note: Run 2a of the cold-agent scenario: a fresh agent given only the landing URL reached /for-agents.md from the landing HTML (band 3), named the three manifest human-only steps, took 8 calls to the login wall, and ran the device-login command. A user with no account has to sign up first and the runbook places login after that, so since the 2026-11-06 owner decision a signup hand-off also ends the task and login is a reported score. The rubric and the baseline note live in docs/operations/agent-evals.md (#4680).

commandTemplate: mkdir -p "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_HOME/claude-cwd" && cd "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_HOME/claude-cwd" && claude -p {instruction} --output-format stream-json --verbose --model sonnet --max-turns 30 --allowedTools mcp__eval-command WebFetch --disallowedTools Bash,BashOutput,KillShell,Read,Edit,Write,NotebookEdit,Glob,Grep,WebSearch,TodoWrite,Task,SlashCommand,ExitPlanMode,Skill,Workflow,ToolSearch,Monitor,CronCreate,CronDelete,CronList,ScheduleWakeup,SendMessage,ListAgents,TaskStop,EnterWorktree,ExitWorktree,PushNotification --mcp-config "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_MCP_CONFIG" --strict-mcp-config
